    print(f"Shape: {exps[i].shape}")
    if 'CropYield' in exps[i].columns:
        print(f"Yield: mean={exps[i]['CropYield'].mean():.2f}, sd={exps[i]['CropYield'].std():.2f}")
    if 'LeafGreennessIndex' in exps[i].columns:
        print(f"Greenness: mean={exps[i]['LeafGreennessIndex'].mean():.2f}")
    if 'EC_Salinity' in exps[i].columns:
        print(f"EC: mean={exps[i]['EC_Salinity'].mean():.2f}")
    if 'PARLight' in exps[i].columns:
        print(f"PAR: mean={exps[i]['PARLight'].mean():.2f}")
    if 'do_iron_fertigation' in exps[i].columns:
        print(f"Iron: values={exps[i]['do_iron_fertigation'].unique()}")
    if 'do_ph_acidifier' in exps[i].columns:
        print(f"pH: values={exps[i]['do_ph_acidifier'].unique()}")
    if 'DissolvedO2Nutrient' in exps[i].columns:
        print(f"DO: mean={exps[i]['DissolvedO2Nutrient'].mean():.2f}")

# Key comparison: Iron dose vs yield
print("\n\n=== IRON DOSE-RESPONSE ===")

    'Iron=0': [
        (exps[5]['CropYield'].mean(), exps[5]['CropYield'].std(), len(exps[5]),
         exps[5]['LeafGreennessIndex'].mean() if 'LeafGreennessIndex' in exps[5].columns else None)
    ],
    'Iron=75': [
        (exps[2]['CropYield'].mean(), exps[2]['CropYield'].std(), len(exps[2]),
         exps[2]['LeafGreennessIndex'].mean()),
        (exps[7]['CropYield'].mean(), exps[7]['CropYield'].std(), len(exps[7]),
         exps[7]['LeafGreennessIndex'].mean())
    ],
    'Iron=100+pH5.8': [
        (exps[4]['CropYield'].mean(), exps[4]['CropYield'].std(), len(exps[4]),
         exps[4]['LeafGreennessIndex'].mean())
    ]
}

for cond, runs in iron_conditions.items():
    all_yields = []
    all_green = []
    for mean, sd, n, green in runs:

    print(f"{cond}: yields={[f'm={r[0]:.2f}, s={r[1]:.2f}' for r in runs]}, greens={all_green}")
